value.rationale: The original robot-identification model makes full five-window binary capacity a natural and operationally meaningful invariant. A complete all-k classification and its unique seven-position obstruction are not a routine substitution: the failure of the naive packing bound is explained by a finite intersection geometry and attained by explicit constructions. The result quantifies simultaneous orientation-identifiable circular labels and separates single-cycle existence from multiple-codeword capacity.
